svg.title: VarMQ multiple queues with round-robin selection
svg.desc: Three empty queues are bound to one worker with concurrency 2 and the RoundRobin strategy. Producers add jobs to all three queues; only the first signal reaches the event loop, the others are dropped because one signal is already pending. The pool starts with a single worker goroutine. The Queue Manager picks the next queue in turn: Queue 1 goes to Worker 1, then Worker 2 is spawned for Queue 2, and the remaining jobs wait. A finished worker stays idle in the pool while enough jobs are queued; idle workers are reused newest first. Each time a worker finishes, its signal lets the event loop dispatch one more job, continuing the rotation with Queue 3 and Queue 1. When Queue 2 is empty the Queue Manager skips it and moves on to Queue 3. As the queues drain, Worker 2 exits because Worker 1 is already idle. Once every queue is empty, later signals find nothing to do and the event loop waits.
